records.command:
sed -n '160,184p' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_export.rs
rg -n 'fn scene' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_export.rs
rg -n 'settings' classic/apps/web/src/components/editor/panels/settings/*.tsx | head -8
rg -n 'fn.*source|source_json' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_source.rs | head -8
sed -n '1,50p' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_automation.rs

python3 - <<'PY'
p='classic/apps/web/src/batch/automation-progress.tsx';s=open(p).read().replace('\t\ttotalVideos,','\t\ttotalVideos,\n\t\twaiting,',1).replace('{ready}/{totalVideos} videos ready','{ready}/{totalVideos} videos ready{waiting > 0 ? ` · ${waiting} waiting in queue` : ""}');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_export.rs';s=open(p).read().replace('let settings = &classic.document["settings"];','let settings = scene.get("settings").unwrap_or(&classic.document["settings"]);');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
